notes.title: Post-Season 2 Patch v2.0.7.0
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/e0a6f8cfb2f53a17a5522a06fb00344b66c68617.png"] Overview❖ v2.0.7.0
The first two items on our content roadmap (Balancing + Bug Fixes, and game optimizations) have been completed.  While our efforts aren't done, we've made considerable enough progress in both departments that we are now comfortable moving forward.

*For details about the roadmap, check out our Content Roadmap post:

[dynamiclink href="https://steamcommunity.com/games/2538000/announcements/detail/519723193024381528"][/dynamiclink]

It's been a while since we've made any major patches, so we're going to take this opportunity to cover not only Season 2 changes, but list changes previously made in Season 1 that were never officially documented.  First let's cover an upcoming event...


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/3777aee3888a6865d0717bb8e79a09f05cc47a92.png"]Events❖ Dojo Masters World Warrior Tournament
  September 20th (8:00pm EST / 5:00pm PST)

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/3e810308578c38c2596c1e7f09f416d86695717f.png"]
Tournament Match Rules:
Matches will be a first-to-5, with Grand Finals being a first-to-10.

Once per set, upon losing a match, you are allowed to change your Martial Art.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/66aa3e96bfab52b84ffd67a52b02398d7c62cb3d.gif"] Click Here To Sign Up For The Tournament [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/5b148ff9cfa06ac7f2d131dba45637fc40723508.gif"]

Watch The Tournament:
  Twitch [dynamiclink href="https://www.twitch.tv/pixeledvisionofficial"][/dynamiclink]

  YouTube [dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/@PixeledVision"][/dynamiclink]


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/e0b9bddfd2f416cf65784c43d74cb692046b20b2.png"] General Changes❖ New Additions
• 4 New Mission Mode missions have been added (Additional missions added each week)

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/4cfe6fd2e62b6407db484245159d940dff3d5784.gif"]

• Revamped cleaner Stamina Bar design when Stamina exceeds 6 bars.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/df3f6ee730aabf650d2892bd28a80dc62602bf4f.gif"]


❖ Optimizations
Main Menu performance has been improved.

Overall gameplay performance improvements.

Performance improvements in regards to in-game Statistics leading to faster game/menu transitions.

Improvements to Steam Achievement/Stats checking performance.

Replays Mode been reworked to be more optimized (Less RAM usage) and less buggy.

Reworked Hitstop interactions in Free-For-All styled matches to scale down for the sake of responsiveness.


❖ General Bug Fixes
Fixed a major desync that could occur when getting a Knockdown when playing online.

Fix for DLC Character Mastery Achievements resetting.

Fix to Netcode to better prevent unintentional disconnects.

Fixed a minor bug that caused players to "not exist" for a single frame on Victory/Taunt.

Fixes to Training Mode FrameData Timeline and Dummy Behaviors to be more consistent/accurate.

Fixed a local Free-For-All displaying the wrong character icons at the Results screen.

Fixed a minor visual bug involving side-preference settings.

Wifi/Ethernet Indicators now display properly (Was previously flipped).

Fixed some Mission Mode loading errors.

Fixed a bug that could cause Mission Mode objects to spawn in other modes unintentionally.

Fixed a softlock when returning to certain menus after playing Co-op Survival Mode.

Fixed a Crash/softlock that could occur when leaving the Glossary Menu.


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/f29616f439d48d83a5dfe196f4c118fc387a7c98.png"]Balance Changes❖ System
• Universally, we've gone through with a fine comb to improve the general readability of gameplay.

 ♦ Most interactions now cause much longer Hitstop (Even more-so on Counter-Hit).

 ♦ Input Buffers have been tweaked to help certain actions flow a bit more comfortably.

 ♦ More VFX, SE, and Feed Text have been added to various interactions to better convey what has occurred.

 ♦ Add pushboxes to most attacks and actions to better prevent awkward player overlapping that could make certain interactions hard to visually parse in some cases.

• Removed a Parry/Guard option-select performed by pressing \[FWD]+\[BWD] simultaneously:

 ♦ Parry now locks itself out for 3 Frames when pressing \[BWD] in neutral.

 ♦ Parry now locks itself out for 7 Frames when pressing \[BWD] while Parry Attempt is Active.


❖ Shotokan Karate
• Retooled Super Uppercut to be more fair and reliable to execute across all input types.

• Super Uppercut now has a "Perfect" variant which occurs when you execute the attack perfectly (Just Frame) with \[FWD]+\[Punch] pressed at the exact same time.

 ♦ This variant has different knockback properties and deals additional base and chip Damage.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/174847925e0d54408162195e316c13c94ea2e8ba.gif"]

• Power Strike now has a "Perfect" variant which occurs when you release the punch at the earliest possible point when reaching max charge.

 ♦ This variant has different knockback properties and deals additional base and chip Damage.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/955faf51820b8f198c6a1b34b8a5f492df68489a.gif"]

• Fixed a bug that could lead to Shotokan Karate sliding indefinitely when getting Hurt while crouching.


❖ Muay Thai
• BWD Walk movement speed has been increased.

• Neutral Jab can now combo into Forward Jab.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/6168b4bad0f88b762c0cfa332a32b99d2839daf1.gif"]

• Neutral Kick now aggressively pushes players back.

• Forward Kick Knockback has been adjusted to not sent air Targets downward.

• Knee Strike has slightly increased recovery on whiff.

• Knee Strike has increased recovery when Blocked.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/6b1de99027fb213f630ecc31c3ea0facfee2729d.gif"]

• Clinch Pummel nudge-velocity now increases in strength with each successive pummel.

• Muay Thai is now at advantage if a Grab Release occurs during Clinch.

• Fixed an oversight that caused Muay Thai's Pummel directions to be randomized.

• Fixed a bug that prevented Muay Thai's Launch Protection from activating against Taekwondo's Double Kicks.


❖ Kendo
• Stab now reliably pushes players back (Weakened at tip).

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/f11aacf72341cc50fbeac6c1e794be7d7492cb69.gif"]

• Stab now carries a bit of momentum.

• Stab can no longer Cancel into itself.

• Knockback of Late Death Blow (Launcher) has been readjusted.

• Knockback of Auto Combo's 3rd hit has been readjusted.

• Kendo now has a Counter-Hit state that occurs when they are interrupted during recovery of Perfect Death Blow.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/30d0b87bcc35d79ed0b60335553e7dc146c8a68a.gif"]

• Kendo can now more reliably Block during recovery of a Dash/Run.

• Fixed a bug that allowed Targets to parry the second hit of Kendo's Auto Combo while in Hitstun.

• Fixed a bug that would cause Kendo's Early Death Blow to softlock the Target in the air.

• Fixed a bug that prevented Kendo's Reversal Counter Slash from occurring and instead Knocked them down.

• All Weapon Attacks now count as both Punch+Kick Type Attacks.


❖ Taekwondo
• Feint Charges reworked slightly to level down when you perform the wrong action instead of completely clearing.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/2e311706899f1b16936f924487f41e540f1af755.gif"]

• Low Kick into High Kick now more reliably combos.

• High Kick can now loop back into Low Kick more comfortably.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/69ecbc268d993387cbc94f7a125280ec2924da75.gif"]

• Spinning High Kick can now cancel into High Kick.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/a9d0dcee2ff97589622279f8cc34d47c7f4b4079.gif"]

• Tornado Kick is now slower on startup, but much safer when on Block.

• Double Kicks now has laggier landing lag On Blocked.

• Jump Kick is now much more punishable on Whiff and on Block.

• Fly Kick now has a lingering Guard-Only Hitbox.  This Hitbox does not deal CHIP.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/31005620bae116ae86a1e541c49e404d19e0f4a4.gif"]

• Roll can now consistently slip past Sumo's Charge Tackle.

• Reworked timing of certain animations to visually flow better (-appear smoother) on screen.


❖ Boxing
• After getting Parried, Boxing's Spin Dash is the Yellow variant.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/c15f3a4e1565fb1e3fef6af1fbec5b40d81da99e.gif"]

• Hook now properly pushes out of targets (Preventing awkward visual overlaps).

• Spin Dashes now consistently slip past Sumo's Charge Tackle.

• Spin Dash charged Strong Attacks now only deal -1/2 Damage to airborne Targets instead of 1.

• Fixed some scripting oversights in Boxing's Shuffle that would lead to a faster than normal Shuffle.

• Fixed a VFX issue with Boxing's Shuffle


❖ Krav Maga
• Weak and Strong Counters Attacks/Grab attempts can now be canceled into Charge Attacks on Whiff.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/4e10cd6665b1565ada31bcad13b5ae96fccf861a.gif"]

• Krav Maga now takes increased Hitstop and Hitstun if they guess the wrong Punch/Kick response.

• Total Takedown Break Points now reduce with each consecutive Total Takedown minigame that occurs.

• Reworked Krav Maga's Movement to be generally snappier/responsive, but also scale with Charge Level.

• Grabbing the Target from behind will initiate a new "Back Stab" behavior that forces the Target into NoTech.

 - If the Target is Weakened, the grab becomes Unbreakable.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/d69bb0a8eeed016e04db0c17faf60fc6039b30ce.gif"]

• Combat Roll can now consistently slip past Sumo's Charge Tackle.

• Combat Roll charge time now reduces the higher your Charge Level.

• Weak Kick Counter now always counts as a Low Attack.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/12b14fc4dc00b1660bf0dee178bf8935085c5c60.gif"]

• Weak Kick Counter can now properly interrupt Sumo's Charge Tackle.

• Weak Punch/Kick now deal more knockback and less Hitstun when hitting a Target who is already in Hitstun.

• Combination Strikes now more reliably hits airborne Targets after Counters.

• Combination Strikes is now a True Combo if the first punch hits a Target who is in Hitstun.

• FWD Dash can now be buffered out of Hitstun and Blockstun.

• Fixed a bug that prevented Krav Maga from Blocking during their Landing animation.


❖ Sumo
• White Sumo Shove now deals -1/2 Damage on Counter-Hit.

• Sumo Shove can now properly counter-hit Targets, with Yellow and Red Sweat variants placing them into a unique delayed air stalled state.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/d392fe190c35e883461a3b3d96de8e5734530fa5.gif"]

• Sumo Shove Weak Armor property is now removed if the attack is Blocked.

• Sumo Takedown's startup is now very briefly susceptible to getting interrupted by Low Attacks.

• Grab now auto-counter-hits airborne Targets, preventing them from Breaking the Grab.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/cb577e1e6c247926e10c9eeb4f9613dc1a24e749.gif"]

• Grab Fakeout can now Juggle Airborne Targets who are in Hitstun.

• Performing a Grab Break now briefly freezes the one who grabbed you (placing Sumo at a slight advantage).

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/842dac729abbcc9c2e9557b7ff42ee5b2e2752a8.gif"]

• Fixed a bug that would lead to Sumo getting Downed while airborne after being thrown.

• Fixed an edge case where Sumo's Sumo Power Sweat Level Color didn't match the respective Sumo Shove strength.


❖ Kyokushin Karate
• Kyokushin Karate is now more easily punishable if they get Parried.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/44c4ef2ed31ffc7819ef6edbcf49c266b666c900.gif"]

• Triangle Kick Hurtbox has been reworked.  It's not less likely to be grabbed or hurt during startup.

• Controlled Breathing OnHit healing now fully stops once you reach Combination 4 until you return to 0.

• Controlled Breathing passive healing now goes on cooldown for half a second when Grabbed/Thrown.

• Fixed a bug that allowed Kyokushin Karate to Block immediately after/while being Thrown.

• Fixed an oversight that allowed Zenshin Armor Hitstop to occur to opponent when Zenshin was interrupted by a Strong Attack.


❖ Capoeira
• Idle Ginga is now slower while Capoeira is Weakened.

• Fixed a few instances of Capoeira returning to the wrong Ginga Stance post-action.

• Improvements to Capoeira's Rhythm Strike VFX to be more in-style with the game's visuals.

• Capoeira now has subtle VFX and SE when reaching Full Ginga.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/f0912ef7a18e3685790bbc92c2f14eda80019146.gif"]

• Capoeira can now cancel FWD Step into BWD Hop (And vise-versa) sooner.

• Capoeira's Low Profile actions now more reliably ignore most opponent pushboxes.

• Fixed a bug that unintentionally gave Capoeira's Low Dodge an upper body Hurtbox when on the Left-Ginga.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/a8b0e5cf0360c292af8d20b36be318d079106ac3.gif"]

• Push Kick now hits slight further forward against Ground Targets.

• Push Kick now starts up faster when performed after a Front cartwheel.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/531db28ff51a9da80d25a88c5a2bfbb32cc4a2a5.gif"]

• Capoeira's Push Kick now has new VFX to better sell the impact.

• Compass Kick has been made more low profile on startup.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/985e0c273e328119fd4a845cd57b41fdd56db276.gif"]

• Crescent Kick is now more low profile on startup.

• Capoeira's Compass and Crescent Kicks now ignore most pushboxes on startup.

• Fixed a bug that prevented Capoeira from Blocking after being Hurt.

• Capoeira now has additional VFX to better convey their Blocking Penalty.

• Capoeira now takes additional Knockback when Blocking a Low Attack.

 ♦ This was done to bring it a bit more inline with Blocking High Attacks and to improve readability.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/f6305e40ed926e446822f297393f4de7ed4d236c.gif"]

• Capoeira now clears their Hurt and Block Penalties when Teching, when Grabbed, when Escaping a Grab, or having their Grab Broken.

• Capoeira now properly transitions into the Airborne Grab Escape animation when escaping a grab while airborne.

• Addressed an oversight that lead Capoeira to having the wrong amount of Hitstun/Blockstun when Hurt/Blocking.

• IF Capoeira is standing-combo'd for 3 hits, they when now "Topple" off their feet to prevent infinites.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/02d61fc8a3b619f9ae660436634b4808255431fc.gif"]

• Fixed a bug that would cause Capoeira to briefly gain additional hurtboxes when attacks were interrupted.

• Added a Pushbox to Capoeira's Arm(s) during the startup of Special Kicks.

• Special Kicks now have much more recovery On Block.

• Improvements to Capoeira's ground shadow to better reflect their movements.

• Fixed a bug that prevented Scissor Grab from occurring when the Target is airborne.

• Scissor Grab now tints gray after the whiffing the grab chance to better convey when you've missed.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/915556643e2105c1dedbebff8e8a4af476df5b14.gif"]

• Fixed a bug that caused Scissor Grab to be unbreakable even while the opponent wasn't Weakened.

• Capoeira's Scissor Grab no longer places target into infinite NoTech.

• Add new Feed Text "Decisive!" when Capoeira lands a Grab on a Weakened Target.

• Capoeira's Trip Grab ("Vingativa") now properly deals Damage on the Throw Frame.

• Capoeira's Scissor Grab and Trip Grab ("Vingativa") now properly places Target into NoTech for 3 seconds.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/90ca30f9016e30871b6ee7283e70029f6c32340f.gif"]

• Cartwheel Strike is now low profile on startup.

• Fixed a hurtbox alignment bug during Cartwheel Strike's Recovery.

• Cartwheel Strike can now be performed during the Neutral Stance portion of their BWDs Hop.

• Cartwheel Strike previously lacked full support for Rhythm Strikes, this has been fixed.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/aac7a46578667d044644a86d7f7664dc2643af77.gif"]

• Add Feed Text "Bad!" when performing one of Capoeira's Special Kick from the wrong Stance.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/0c2b73476790d88e86d862e3e30351dce52b00c6.gif"]

• Reworked Front and Back Cartwheel's Hurtboxes to be more low profile and to better avoid Grabs.

• Front and Back Cartwheels now add to their Ginga Steps.

• Front and Back Cartwheels now more reliably avoid highs (and some mid Attacks).

• Front and Back Cartwheels now recover faster when at Full Ginga.

• Front and Back Cartwheels now startup much faster when performed from Neutral Stance.

• Back Cartwheel's anti-air Hitbox range has been increased.

• Back Cartwheel's travel distance now lessened when performed from a Back Stance with it even further lessened while in Full Ginga.

• Removed 3 Capoeira infinites.

• Added more appropriate Special Indicators for Capoeira in Training Mode to represent their Rhythm Strikes ♪

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/696ee933fe8730a9ed1dfed338e36ff7cdfd3182.gif"]

notes.title: Season 2 Update + DLC
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/e0b9bddfd2f416cf65784c43d74cb692046b20b2.png"] Thanks for your patience, Dojo Masters' Season 2 Update is finally live!

*We are currently looking into having a Sale on the base-game to coincide with the Season 2 + DLC drop.  Currently Valve's systems won't allows us to due to having previously going on Sell during EVO Weekend.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/ccbab2e1dc33f1c4abd368e6657463037263f7d9.gif"]


What's New?
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/47d6cf36e80656174053c5e80105efb9b98f6a3a.png"]This update contains a general system rebalance, a (mostly) new menu interface, a new mission mode with new missions added weekly, a few new stages, performance improvements.



In addition to the update, we released the game's first DLC.  A Bundle containing 3 new characters (Sumo, Kyokushin Karate, and Capoeira) and 2 new stages (ARENA-3 "Sumo Arena", and SPORT-1 "Hockey Rink"), as well as 3 new exclusive Martial Art music themes!!


Full details on what's in the update can be found here:[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2538000/view/666089007291040352"][/dynamiclink]Get the DLC[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3807730/Dojo_Masters__Expansion_Pack_1"][/dynamiclink]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/e0a6f8cfb2f53a17a5522a06fb00344b66c68617.png"]This upcoming weekend we will be outlining the roadmap of future content that will be coming to the game in the future.  From game modes, polls, tournaments, characters, and eventual console ports.

notes.title: Season 2: Update on the progress of the Delay!
notes.content:
What's the Status of the Update?!
[img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//44456438/66aa3e96bfab52b84ffd67a52b02398d7c62cb3d.gif"] As mentioned in a previous post, we had ran into some roadblocks that prevented us from releasing the update.  It was very important that we investigated and tackled them.  While we had estimated it only taking a few hours to address, it ended up taking much longer than expect.

With that said, and with the bugs finally addressed.  We've internally decided to take one final day to really make sure that everything is ready-to-go!



Thanks so much for your continued patience, the update will be worth it.
We'll see you Monday!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/e0b9bddfd2f416cf65784c43d74cb692046b20b2.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/e0a6f8cfb2f53a17a5522a06fb00344b66c68617.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/47d6cf36e80656174053c5e80105efb9b98f6a3a.png"]

notes.title: Season 2 Update + Expansion Pack DLC minor delay
notes.content:
Minor Delay
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/66aa3e96bfab52b84ffd67a52b02398d7c62cb3d.gif"] A few unforeseen hiccups were encountered in prep for the Season 2 Update + Expansion Pack DLC.  At minimum, we are approximately 8~9hrs behind schedule.  We hope that it doesn't extend much longer than that...  We're working as fast as we can!  Please bare with us as we attempt to get everything fixed and finalized.  Apologies for the delay 🙏 



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/5b148ff9cfa06ac7f2d131dba45637fc40723508.gif"] Lastly, once the update does drop, we plan on having a Discount for base game.

notes.title: Dojo Masters Expansion Pack (DLC)
notes.content:
Dojo Masters Season 2!
It's been a little over a year since Dojo Masters launched.  We've been busy behind the scenes cleaning things up, improving systems, prepping new content, and designing more ways to play.  We felt it was about time that we added something new.


So, what's in Season 2?❖ Martial Art Improvements![img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/5b148ff9cfa06ac7f2d131dba45637fc40723508.gif"] Balance and System changes
All Martial Arts are being re-balanced to align with the content in the Season 2 update.  

Additionally, we have been chipping away at some really niche bugs and oversights across the board to make things more consistent.

Lastly, we have been experimenting with and tweaking various aspects from gameplay-flow, execution, readability, VFX, audio queues, and the like.  So expect things to feel slightly different once the update arrives.  And we will continue to make improvements as the updates continue to roll out.


❖ Expansion Pack DLC![previewyoutube="48ODBo5mTpQ;full"][/previewyoutube] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/66aa3e96bfab52b84ffd67a52b02398d7c62cb3d.gif"] First up on the chopping block!!
3 New Martial Arts will be joining the roster: 
Sumo
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/ccbab2e1dc33f1c4abd368e6657463037263f7d9.gif"]
Kyokushin Karate
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/fee7087c1a1e592eb1b4ddf291f56cf22bde63a4.gif"]
and the highly requested Capoeira!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/eeb1ad77f210042125552da7e5511a1c97de0aab.gif"]


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/5b148ff9cfa06ac7f2d131dba45637fc40723508.gif"] Next up on the chopping block!!
The Expansion Pack also comes with 2 Exclusive Stages: 
ARENA-3 \\\\The Sumo Stage
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/5d773a540fe52e71945233e65facc33752802c1f.gif"]
SPORT-1 \\\\The Hockey Rink
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/4ee3d687fb3607bc956d216f4a1c2f5f4ffa05a6.gif"]

Lastly, the DLC pack comes with 3 new exclusive Martial Art music tracks from our amazing composer.
This Expansion Pack is scheduled to drop on August 21st.
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3807730/Dojo_Masters__Expansion_Pack_1/"][/dynamiclink](Dojo Masters: Expansion Pack (DLC) is paid DLC)


❖ Mission Mode
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/84f1cd2bec2e7853bcf809212bc988a1eea8504a.gif"]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/66aa3e96bfab52b84ffd67a52b02398d7c62cb3d.gif"] Looking for a challenge?  
Mission Mode is a free new single-player game mode designed to challenge you in a variety of unique scenarios.  Aim for the Gold Trophies!

Season 2 will launch with 4 Missions.  With new missions added every week (up until we run out of ideas).  We can't wait to show you what we've got cooking :P


❖ An Updated Look
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/f78e5711ecb8c0b518ef7886ec8c7ff3d1be9383.gif"]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/5b148ff9cfa06ac7f2d131dba45637fc40723508.gif"] A fresh new look!
Along with all of these new additions, we will also be updating Dojo Master's menu interface.  While it still isn't complete (A handful of menus still need to be converted), we felt that it would be a missed opportunity not to give you guys a taste of the new look when Season 2 drops.


❖ New Stages[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/66aa3e96bfab52b84ffd67a52b02398d7c62cb3d.gif"] 3 new Stages for a change of scenery
Season 2 will include 3 new generic stages to play on.  While these stages are primarily designed for the new Mission Mode, they are also planned to be used in some future unannounced content...
ROOM-1
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/037a7ea47f9611b6e51ae762dcd2d820f0ae44c8.png"]
ROOM-2
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/cc024504a8969314992b467ecfe00b9f3ee19b9e.png"]
COURTYARD-1
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/0154988b26794dddc8414524f6e4ecdd288cb985.png"]


❖ Ranked Mode?[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/5b148ff9cfa06ac7f2d131dba45637fc40723508.gif"] Where Is Ranked?
While originally planned the Ranked mode update to be sometime shortly after launch, we ran into a lot of roadblocks that prevented us from releasing Dojo Masters' Ranked Mode in a fully functional state.  

Unfortunately, we still need a little more time to work some things out.  We have a lot of playtesting to do before it is ready.  Once Season 2 releases we will be putting all of our effort into making Ranked our next top priority.  Ideally, we're targeting a month after, but we apologize for the further delay 🙏

With all of that said, at the very least, I would like to loosely detail how exactly Ranked will function once it releases.  Just to give you a small taste of what we're setting up.

*Reminder: Ranked Mode will be a free update. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/8203f169b0f99ec1ff7e9f3a48ba317be4eea8ad.png"]

*Mockup image for reference
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/66aa3e96bfab52b84ffd67a52b02398d7c62cb3d.gif"] How Will Ranked Work?
Ranks are determined by belts.  Every player starts off without one.  Once you've won your first match, you are rewarded a basic white belt and this belt can never be lost.  There are 20* unique belt ranks.

Every Rank has an RP(Ranked Points) requirement to move up to the next belt.  The requirement increases as you climb.  Each Ranked Match will be a First-to-3 set.  Meaning, you can earn up to 3 RP per ranked match.  

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/7f5e146954340423b37c77a9bf781ada4c73f5b4.png"]

Every round-win rewards you +1 RP, losing to a player of the same rank loses you -1 RP, but losing to a player of a lower Rank will drop your current belt rank by 1.  However, if you've lost your belt to a player of a lower rank, you can win the subsequent round(s) to boost yourself back up a belt, but now starting at the beginning of that rank's RP.

Ranked Belts will be tied to the individual Martial Art.  So you can begin the climb from a White Belt with a new Martial Art without fear of losing your progress with another.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/a91761dfedc970839a9421faa1411ba34cf93f3a.png"]

Lastly, if you don't maintain your Ranked play for a long period of time, your Ranked Martial Arts will gradually begin depreciating in rank until they've returned down to a White Belt.

*Ranked Mode details are subject to change.


❖ What's Next?[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/5b148ff9cfa06ac7f2d131dba45637fc40723508.gif"] We hope to see you at Season 2's Launch!
Around launch-time, we will be running a few community events, as well as laying out a roadmap of future content.  So keep an eye out for more details!



-Also, All previous Replay Data will be lost one the Season 2 patch drops due to incompatibility.

notes.title: Pre-Ranked Balance Patch (v1.0.9.0b)
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/411b47b9d4c58e3fe6062b89136bc5c0a0b04fde.png
Pre-Ranked Balance Patch
We are unfortunately a little behind schedule (Not just because of prepping for our recent showing at East Coast Throwdown, but our lead dev came down with the flu).  With that said, we think it would be best to at least push the most recent balance changes (and bug fixes) in preparation for Ranked.

We still need a little bit longer to get Ranked Mode up and ready, but as soon as we have additional details to share we will let you know!

Patchnotes
❖ System Changes ❖
 Introduced a new Pseudo-Hitstun and Pseudo-Blockstun mechanic. Acts similarly to normal stun states but doesn't interrupt your current action, and locks you out of performing actions.
 This was introduced to address an oversight in Krav Maga's Hit-Counters weren't interacting properly On Blocked.
❖ Balance Changes ❖
Shotokan Karate

 Crouch:
Re-Crouching now properly plays the correct Hurt Reaction.
Hitstun now properly carries over when hit while crouching.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/b3412a50a265cc63618cb5a2f10b2ac13222a516.gif

Muay Thai

 Kick on whiffed Perfect Sweep:
 On Hit (-2 → -5)
 On Blocked (-28 → -33)
 Forward Kick on whiffed Perfect Sweep:
 On Hit (-2 → -5)
 On Blocked (-20 → -25)
 Knee:
 AI is now slightly less likely to spam the Knee.
 Clinch:
 Recovery on Grab Broken increased (-14 → -25)
 Break window of Non-Perfect Sweeps increased  (1 → 6)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/07c0375ee833dee9e0fbf358a432e2a65dedfdb0.gif

Kendo

 Counter Stance:
 No longer allowed to break Initial Grabs while in Stance.
 Dash Counter Stance:
 No longer allowed to break Initial Grabs while in Stance.
 Getting Parried will now always allow you to be punished appropriately.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/d40e37fa34b8f1b06c9a18fc51fcf787518596d6.gif

Taekwondo

 High Kick:
 Less likely to hit targets standing behind them
 Backward Feint:
 Readjusted Hurtbox to allow for slightly easier grab escapes.
 Super Feint Forward Kick:
 Blockstun increased (8 → 17)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/102d98cd672f22221d7ba7527fc17424a070b7db.gif

Boxing

 Uppercut:
 Updated Hitbox to be less likely to hit airborne targets on cross-up.
 Reduced upward knockback of Spindash Uppercut from (-3 → -2)
 Spindash(Green):
 Activation Hitstop has been reduced (20 → 15)
 SpinDash Uppercut:
 Hitstop against airborne targets reduced (20 → 15)
 SpinDash Hook:
 Hitstop against airborne targets reduced (25 → 15)
 SpinDash:
 All strong attacks now deal 50% less damage against airborne targets.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/4afa6f7f07eebb9f2bd2d74fa0747b22abf1f0f4.gif

Krav Maga

 Combat Roll:
 Blockstun increased (+8 → +16)
 Backwards Momentum is now completely killed upon use to prevent accidental stalling.
 Hit-Counters:
 Both Punch and Kick Hit-Counters now deal 5 Frames of Pseudo-Blockstun.
 Getting Parried will now always allow you to be punished appropriately.
 Total Takedown:
 Every consecutive Total Takedown that has been initiated will now decrease the amount of necessary guesses needed to confirm the Knockdown. Will reset to 3 guesses on Round Reset.
 Number of guesses will never drop below 1.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/3da348b6984ea9286071cfd846066abbf2ee3371.gif


❖ Training Mode ❖

 Fixed a bug that would cause the Training Dummy to perform Behavior Acts multiple times on Blockstun-Recovery.
 Fixed the "Grabbed" Behavior(While) state for the Training Dummy as it was treating Hitstun as being Grabbed.
 Resetting the Scene no longer clears the displayed info from the FrameData Timeline.

❖ Netplay ❖
Stability

 Fixed the illusive community named "Top" bug where you would get a connection error after certain network interactions after being in an online match for too long.
 Addressed a massive oversight in Hitbox/Hurtbox interactions that would eventually lead to desyncs across Online Matches.
 You can now properly pause the game during match transitions while playing online.
 Potentially fixed some edge-case netplay softlocks.
Lobbies

 Updated default Custom Lobby settings to be
  Room A: VS ∞ Matches
  Room B: VS 10 Matches
  Room C: VS 10 Matches
  Room D: Training Mode New Lobby Welcome Message

❖ Misc. ❖

 Addressed some input related oversights where the game would register unassigned controllers.
 Addressed an a very rare oversight that would prevent a character from interacting with a Hurtbox that they have previously interacted with.
 Players will no longer interact with the Pushbox of the a Player that they are grabbing.
   This was adversely affecting Muay Thai's Clinch Grab Pummel interactions. Added a delay when pressing the {B} button at the results screen so that you're less likely to accidentally quit a match due to mashing.
 Stage Change Button at Results Screen (As well as for Spectators) now always randomizes on the first click, and cycles in order on repeated presses.
 Fixed an unexpected graphical image involving after images on certain stages. Ex. ARENA-1's screen projector Changed the text "SETTINGS" for the ONLINE Menu to "CONFIG".
 Fixed a minor visual bug involving Grab Indicators for P3 and P4 in Free-For-All.
 Minor improvements to Arabic localization in the Activity Feed.
 Potentially fixed a bug that would cause a text entry field to linger on screen.
 Minor improvements to character select box ordering/positioning.

❖ Workshop ❖

 Doodle Chan has been updated to fix a few graphical issues.
 Potentially fixed a bug that could cause the wrong Workshop Mods to show up in the wrong Manage Menus.
 Editor has been updated to DX11 to prevent graphical crashes.
 Fixed multiple UX issues with the Editor.
 Updated the Frame Data Timeline to display GoTo tooltips if pointing to the same Sequence.

notes.title: Minor Patch (v1.0.1.2)
notes.content:
Pre Ranked Patch
This update addresses some newly discovered bugs as well as some minor quality of life changes.

In the next update, we should be rolling out Ranked Mode, as well as the early steps to having proper P2P connection support for most users.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/66aa3e96bfab52b84ffd67a52b02398d7c62cb3d.gif

Patchnotes:
Netplay

 Getting a Matchmaking match while at Character Select now properly plays a screen transition.
 The Host of a Lobby should now be the only one to receive the Disband Warning popup.


Arcade Mode

 Fixed a bug that caused your score and difficulty to carry over on Arcade Mode Retries and Character Changes post-Game Over.
 Minor improvements to the pacing during Match Transitions while Traditional KO game Rule is active in Arcade Mode.

 Entering Replay Mode with a Side-Preference set, will no longer cause the Pause Menu elements to overlap themselves.

 Made some minor improvements to the JP translation.


Steam Workshop

 Fixed a bug that caused Workshop Mods to reinstall themselves after being uninstalled.
 Applied multiple fixes to how the Workshop MANAGE Menu displays Items.
 Local and orphaned Mod Files can now properly be deleted from the Workshop MANAGE Menu.

notes.title: Post-Launch Patch #3 (v1.0.1.0)
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/f1b9e34fee4ece65ddd2a9a2d88c93403fd2f5cc.png
The third (and hopefully final) Post-Launch Patch addressing major bugs!
It took quite some time (given our initial expectations were to have this ready by August 1st), but it's finally ready.

This patch addresses many issues regarding Performance, Netplay, Menu Navigation, Quality of Life Inclusions/Changes, as well as some minor balance changes.  Our aim is to make this the final major bug-fix patch so that we can move forward and prep for things such as Ranked Mode and more.  Undoubtedly, there will be more unexpected bugs that arise, but hopefully at least now the game is relatively stable and we can fix the minor bugs in smaller patches.

As mentioned in our previous post, this build (v1.0.1.0) will render all old Replays incompatible.  While this is normal expected behavior as the game state, character interactions, and systems change, we want to investigate methods for allowing playback of outdated replay files at some point in the future.

Additionally, while Dojo Masters isn't officially support on the Steam Deck/Proton (Nor do we own a Steam Deck ourselves), we will still continue to make an effort to support it to the best of our abilities.

Lastly, on the topic of Ranked Mode.  Admittedly, we are a bit behind schedule due to addressing network issues.  With that said, we are still committed to having Ranked Mode up and running before the end of the month. {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/66aa3e96bfab52b84ffd67a52b02398d7c62cb3d.gif

Patchnotes
❖ Balance Changes ❖
Muay Thai

 Forward Jab:
Hitstop on Parried 20 → 25
Blockstun Reduced from 5 → 3
Recoil OnHit increase from 0 → -1
 Forward Kick:
Hitstop on Parried 25 → 30
Blockstun Reduced from 8 → 5
Recoil OnHit increase from 0 → -1 Clinch Grab/Pummel:
Can now be interrupted during the the grab portion of the sequence. Only really useful in Free-For-All and Survival Modes.Krav Maga

 Total Takedown:
Can now be interrupted during the Takedown sequence. Only really useful in Free-For-All and Survival Modes.Kendo

 Dashing Strike:
  Startup increased by 1 Frame to make the attack -5 on Hit. This was done to prevent an infinite.
Hurtbox Updated to better reflect visuals. Weak Death Blow:
Hurtbox Updated to better reflect visuals.
❖ Netplay ❖
Stability

 Fixed a major bug that would cause the game to unexpected crash while in Matchmaking (And just playing online in general) for Steam Deck/Proton users.
 Made further improvements to the handling of returning to Character Select when playing online in slower connections.

 It should now be less likely to desync/disconnect players. Fixed a bug that could lead to a player being stuck at Character Select despite the opponent having already disconnected.
 Fixed a bug that could cause players to disconnect from Matches in Matchmaking if the game sent more than one match challenge/request in a short amount of time.
 Potentially addressed a bug that would cause Matchmaking Preferences to interfere with Custom Lobby Room Rules.
 In the extremely rare case where the game is refusing to send UDP Packets during an online match, it will now fallback to TCP Packets to prevent softlocks and connection timeouts.

In simple terms: Game will better solve unexpected connection issues mid-match. General improvements to the game state to better prevent desyncs from occurring.
Lobbies

 Added a warning dialog prompt that informs a Lobby Host that they are closing the lobby and potentially ending matches prematurely.

 There is also an option to "Warn" the other users that the Lobby will be closing soon.Misc.

 While in Matchmaking, if the opponent leaves at the Results Screen, you are no longer kicked out.

 This allows you to save a Replay of a player who would have previously prevented you from doing so by leaving before you were able to. "Warrior Spirit" cosmetic should now properly display for your opponent when playing online.
 Fixed a bug that allowed players to retain their Win Streak when they lose due to a TimeUp.
 Scoreboard/Progression should no longer be reset randomly during Matchmaking while in Local Game Modes.

❖ Navigation ❖

 All in-game Menus (Results Screens and Pause Menus) can now be navigated with the Mouse Cursor.
 Results, Pause, Character Select, and Main Menu navigation has been standardized and will no longer strictly rely on the mapped inputs for a given Player Controller Slot.

 Keyboard Mapped Controller slots will still use the old behavior as long as no controller is connected to the Player Controller Slot in question. All Local Multiplayer Modes now contain a "Button Remap" Button at Character Select.
 This should make it easier to remap controls in local gatherings without having to exit out and return to the Settings Menu. Fixed a bug that could lock-up user inputs after interacting with a Popup in certain menus.
 Navigation Inputs should no longer interfere with certain Menus when the Steam Overlay is active
❖ Gameplay ❖
System Changes

 An oversight caused the lockout that was intended to be applied when unsuccessfully attempting a Parry wasn't occurring.  This has since been fixed.
 Fixed a bug that prevented players from buffering Parries during non-cancelable states.
 Fixed an oversight with Tech Animations that didn't uniformly allow all characters to Parry during their descent.

 This previously lead to unfair Tech Traps scenarios, and lead to only a couple characters being able to take advantage of the Air Parry Mechanic consistently.
Tutorials and Trials

 The input to progress the Tutorial and Trials dialogue has been changed to [Start].

 It even comes with a nifty tooltip indicator if the players takes too long to proceed.
 Pausing during a Tutorial/Trial now requires that you hold the [Start] Button for half a second.
Results Screen

 Added a shortcut offer Kudos at the Results screen by pressing [Select]
 Navigation no longer wraps around vertically.

 Should prevent players from accidentally overshooting and selecting "QUIT" when they want "KUDOS". Pressing [Start] to cancel a Results Screen Decision will now longer rapidly spam.
 Pressing [Select] when highlighting the ⛩️ Icon will change the Stage's Variant.
 Performing a Screen Flip will no longer duplicate the Results Screen Buttons.Pause Menu

 While playing multiplayer modes, Pausing the game has been changed to a "Hold To Pause" behavior.

 This was done primarily to prevent accidental pausing when attempting to skip Round Transitions.
Arcade Mode

 Players can now choose to "Rematch" after a Game Over in Arcade Mode.

 You can also now save the replay of the match that you lost.
Survival Mode

 Enemies' Base Stamina has been globally reduced.

 Previously, it would take slightly too long to get kills in Survival Mode.  While this wasn't technically an issue, it didn't fully capture that feeling we were aiming for and have adjusted it to better reflect our vision.
 Added a "Crowd Control" behavior to enemy CPU Logic. This causes them to more respectfully swarm players in a slightly less overwhelming manner.
 Strong Enemies can now be eliminated with Untechable Attacks again.

 After some consideration, allowing them to recover and respawn was a bit too annoying to deal with once you get to the later stages of Survival Mode.
 Strong Enemies now reward more Stamina than a normal enemy when Overkilled.
 Overkill Flash has been retuned to be more consistent and rewarding.
 Enemies eliminated via Overkill will now gray out and order behind the action to better reduce clutter.
 Enemies eliminated via Overkill will now fall at a fixed rate to reward players at a more expected rate.
 Every successful Knockout will now skip +1sec of the Revive Timer in Co-Op Survival Mode.
 You can now use Screen Flip/Shuffle Button at Results screen in Solo-Survival Mode.Team VS

 Fixed a bug that prevented Stamina from carrying over between rounds.

 Previously, the surviving player would start the next round/character-transition with 0 Stamina.
Free-For-All

 Due to the new inclusion of a Button Remap Button in Free-For-All Character Select, the "←"(Exit) Button no longer exists, and thus users will now have to hold the [Cancel] Button down for half a second in order to exit the menu.
 Results Menu Player Icons now animate much quicker to better signal your selection state once a decision is made.
 Free-For-All Menu Button's text has been changed from "VS 3P/4P" to "4 PLAYERS" to be more understandable.

 Escape on the Keyboard also works.
BOT VS

 Fixed a behavior that could lead to the AI indefinitely baiting each other's attacks and not progressing the match.
Training Mode

 Fixed a bug that could prevent users from increasing Stamina Values in Training Mode when the designated Character has more Base Stamina than what is normally expected.

❖ General ❖
Replays

 Replays older than v1.0.1.0 will no longer be viewable.
 Replays should be slightly more consistent and reliable when saving.
 Meaning: They should be less likely to become corrupted/empty. Replay Takeover Menu was visually disabling the Player Buttons.  This has since been fixed.
 Replay Takeover now properly functions when attempting to take over a CPU Player.
 Replays now tend to adopt the name of the Game Mode when a Player's name isn't given.Misc.

 Eliminated "❌" Symbol now properly Flips along with Screen Flip/Side-Preference.
 Minor improvement to performance while in Menus.
 Game client should more consistently interface with the Steam Client.
 Made minor improvements to how the game interacts with steam user folders.
 Fixed a typo in the Match Conclusion Text when getting a Perfect KO in Traditional KO Mode.
 Added some additional informative popups to the game to better inform players of things they might have missed.

 More of these will make their way into the game in the future.  It's a matter of finding the confusing points and tackling them on a case-by-case basis. Added more notifications for the various error cases in the game so that you are better informed as to what might be breaking when things do.
 Further decreased volume of the Logo segment when launching the game.
 Addressed some localization oddities with the JP translation.
 Fixed issues that prevented some Character Select Elements from displaying properly, as well one issues that would cause some elements to remain when they shouldn't.

❖ Achievements ❖

 Addressed an oversight that had the achievement for winning 1 with the 10-wins icon and caused the actual winning 10 matches online achievement to not appear in your library. 
 General improvements to how achievement tracking is checked.
 Fixed a bug with the Achievement tied to Traditional KO mode.
 Corrected a few typos discovered in the Brazilian Portuguese (PT-BR) achievements.

❖ Steam Workshop ❖

 Dojo Masters' Editor Tool (Used with the Steam Workshop) now properly has its Steam Page up and running and the tool should be downloadable for all looking to get into Workshop creation.
 Added notifications for when you have reached you Workshop File Limit or Storage Space Limit when unsuccessfully attempting to upload to the Steam Workshop.
 Doodle Chan has been updated to include all of the recent system fixes as well as to address a small oversight in their Tech Action.
 Fixed a scripting bug in Doodle Chan that allowed them to indefinitely cause a Counter-Hit (Visually).
 Local Mod Characters and Skins will now be properly displayable at Character selected, denoted by a "!" when usability is allowed but with exceptions.

notes.title: Hotfix #6 1.0.0.9
notes.content:
Major Matchmaking and Netplay Fixes
Apologies to those who may have been experiencing Matchmaking and connection issues for the past two days.  The cause of these issues has been determined, and we should now be able to move forward with better caution to avoid similar disruptions to the service in the future 🥋

Patchnotes:
Netplay

 Fixed a major bug that would silently remove the player from Matchmaking after 40 seconds, thus making it impossible to engage with Global Matchmaking.
 Removed a behavior that was causing the game to hang/freeze when attempting to close after connecting to a game server.
 Fixed a (new?) Results Screen bug that could cause an indefinite softlock when selecting Character Select/Change.
 Fixed a 5 second softlock when making decisions at the results screen in unstable connections.
 Fixed a false connection error symbol at the start of matches with high ping.
 Addresed an oversight that allowed users to modify their Matchmaking Parameters while still in the Matchmaking Queue.
 Matchmaking button now disables when your game fails to load the server list.
This was leading to crashes when attempting to connect to non-existent servers.
Replays

 Applied a fix to an oversight in replay files.  There should be less replay file corruption and lost data.
VS CPU replays still currently suffer from the occasional corruption. Potentially fixed an issue where the Side-Preference setting wasn't properly reflected in Replays.

Misc.

 Fixed a bug that would cause Muay Thai to not load in for the require Tutorial Segments.
 Menus have been further optimized to run smoother.
 Minor navigation fixes.
 Free-For-All Character Map Icons no longer remain on screen while at Character Select.

notes.title: Hotfix #5 1.0.0.7
notes.content:
For those experiencing Crashes
Thanks to user @Gundofox, we have discovered the cause of a few crashes and network issues!

Please update to v1.0.07 as soon as possible!  If you are still encountering crashes please let us know.  We are trying our best to address these issues as everyone's PC setup is different, so we appreciate your patience.

Patchnotes:

 Fixed an object reference bug that would cause certain users to be unable to engage with the application and thus causing a crash.

 This may or may not have also fixed the Matchmaking crashes that some users have been experiencing.
 Fixed a bug that could cause users to get stuck at the results screen when a player quits a match too quickly.
 Fixed an achievement bug when initially connecting to an online match.

notes.title: Post-Launch Patch #2 (v1.0.0.6)
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/ea5953bbdb72ddc94a20d4077f66443593319316.png
One More Post-Launch Patch To Go!
We are now 50% through our backlog of Launch Bugs!!  While there are a few that will take quite some time to tackle, we are pushing to have all addressable bugs and concerns finished by/before August 1st.

The next patch will include character balance changes, Workshop Fixes, as well as some additional polish and general QoL changes!  After that, it's onward to new content 👊

Patchnotes:
Netplay

 Potential improvements to prevent crashes when in matchmaking for certain users.
 Improvements to how the game determines which Region Server is best.
 Matchmaking will now properly traverse regions from closest to farthest.
 Fixed a bug that would prevent users from traversing all regions during matchmaking.
 Fixed a bug that would cause users to end up on the wrong regional server when attempting to enter a Private Room after being in Matchmaking.
 Attempting to join a Private Lobby should now properly cancel if a connection issue or timeout has been detected.
 Potentially fixed a bug that would allow scoreboard to carryover across sessions and game modes.
 Added a fallback system in cases where matches hang for too long and are unable to properly communicate with their opponent(s).


Gameplay

 Updated Input System to a new SDL version (May come with improved compatibility).
 Fixed a bug that would lock the players inputs, preventing them from completing Tutorials/Trials until [Down] was pressed.
 Survive BGM♪ now no longer shows up in the random track rotation (The track can still be manually select)
 "Press Start" Notification now properly displays at the Results screen when playing offline/locally.


Survival Mode

 Minor adjustments to how often weaker enemies block attacks.
 Adjustments to how often weaker enemies break free of Grabs.
 Strong Enemy Stamina has been reduced by 30~%
 Overkill Bonus threshold has been reduced to make it more satisfying and rewarding to go for.
 Overkill Bonus now triggers faster when performing a combo on airborne targets.


Achievements

 Potentially fixed an issue that would cause save files to store incorrect or corrupted data when losing connectivity with Steam.
 Fixed a bug that would allow online opponents to unlock achievements for you.
 Potential fix for players sometimes unlocking achievements when they shouldn't.


Misc.

 Private Lobby Menu has been updated to include a Server Button for easier navigation/setup.
 Minor improvements to how the game recognizes the user's System Language.
 Minor rewording of "REGION" (Region Lock) Matchmaking Parameter to be more descriptive.
 Minor menu navigation improvements.
 Minor menu visual fixes.

notes.title: Post-Launch Patch #1 (v1.0.0.5)
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/6cdee16e0b35e25f76c28f95fe0637b2eb7f20df.png
There is still a lot of work to be done, but this patch should address some of the more egregious issues.  Expect one more Patch before the end of July.

In the next patch we will be tackling additional Workshop Improvements, Netplay improvements, Minor Character Balance, and hopefully some more compatibility features.

Patchnotes:
Gameplay

 Solved an bug that would cause Stage Audio to repeatedly restart when music was set to Auto  or Random.
 Fixed a bug that prevented Training Mode's "Block" AI Behavior to stop working when displaying Hitboxes.
 Replays should now properly display the username of the players involved if applicable.


Netplay

 Solved an oversight that would disconnect players if one player took too long to make their character and Stage selection.
 Fixed a bug that caused Matchmaking parameters to interfere with Private Lobbies.
 Region, WIFI, and Custom Mod Matchmaking Filters should now properly function.

   Region Filter now defaults to being turned off.
 Online Survival Mode should no longer desync as long as all players have the same active character roster.


Achievements

 Krav Maga's Mastery Achievement should finally be working as intended.
 Survival Mode's Untouchable Achievement should now function as expected.


System Related

 Potentially solved a bug that prevented some users from getting pass the BGM Loading Step when launching the game.
 The main cause of characters not properly loading their sprites when playing offline (-Or while using the Preload Characters Setting) has been solved.

 We are still investigating all additional causes of this bug.
 Fixed a bug that prevented the game from immediately disconnecting from the match in case of error.
 Fixed a DX9Fallback issue that could cause the application to infinitely loop when the user lacked proper write permissions.
 All Text has been scaled down when launching the application in DX9 mode.
 Text should no longer be reversed when playing with a preferred side preference.
 Minor improvements to how the game interacts with the Steam Client.
 Fixed an issue that would cause the game to connect non-existent controllers when launching the game.
 Removed the Character Selection Countdown Clock Sound when playing in modes that do not display the timer.
 Minor menu navigation improvements.


Workshop

 Local Skin Mods (Character Skin Mods not uploaded to Workshop) should now function online.
 Potentially fixed a bug that prevented users from deleting Mods that aren't present in the Workshop.

notes.title: Hotfix #4 1.0.0.4
notes.content: Fixed a bug that could prevent users from loading characters when the game fails to communicate with Steam properly.

notes.title: Launch Hotfix v1.0.0.3
notes.content:
Improvements to Matchmaking (More likely to remain on your region's Server)
 Users who aren't on the same version will no longer be matched up against each other.
 Skin Mods should more reliably display for opponents when playing online.
 Potential disconnect fixes.

notes.title: Addressing and Tackling Launch Bugs
notes.content:
https://i.postimg.cc/h4QdnCLV/Dojo-Masters-Pixel-Banner.png
Hello,
We are making this post to draw attention to some common bugs that we are currently working on, are currently investigating, as well as a few features we plan on getting in a soon a possible:

In Progress

 More improvements to Matchmaking.
 Players getting matched against those who haven't updated their game client, and thus are unable to begin the match.
 Controls getting locked while in the Tutorial.
 Skins sometimes not showing up for opponents while playing.
 Adjustment to Survival Mode CPU to prevent them from hugging the edges of the screen as often as they do.
 Side Preference Match Settings are causing Loading Screen Text to flip.


Investigating

 Character's not fully loading when entering a match (Causing characters to be completely invisible)
 Horrible frame drops after failing to connect to a match.
 Online Survival Mode is desyncing at the start of the match.
 General low framerates on the Steam Deck.
 Getting stuck on the BGM Loading Step when launching the game.
 Some BGM Tracks failing to initialize properly and thus causing it to constantly restart the intro.


Future Plans

 Ability to instantly retry Arcade Mode after a Game Over.
 Further adjustments to Tutorials and Trials to better convey certain aspects that may confuse a few players (As well as demonstrations)
 In-game access to the game's workshop tools (Waiting on a response from Valve in order to fix this issue).



We're trying our best to address as many as possible, as soon as possible, with almost all of our current efforts being focused on addressing matchmaking/match loading bugs.  Many unexpected things broke on launch, but we appreciate your patience as we try and tackle everything.  Expect multiple updates/patches throughout the next few days!

Thanks,
Pixeled Vision
